join_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.state = 'California'

join_02.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

join_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Calvin Klein'

join_04.sql: SELECT AVG(age) FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders)

join_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN distribution_centers d ON d.id = p.distribution_center_id WHERE d.name = 'Memphis TN'

join_06.sql: SELECT u.traffic_source, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.traffic_source ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

join_07.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id)

join_08.sql: SELECT AVG(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.department = 'Women'

date_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2022-01-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-01'

date_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2021-01-01' AND created_at < '2021-04-01'

date_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE created_at >= '2023-03-15' AND created_at < '2023-03-16'

date_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2020-02-01' AND created_at < '2020-03-01'

date_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2022-01-01' AND created_at < '2022-02-01'

date_06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE delivered_at >= '2022-07-01' AND delivered_at < '2023-01-01'

date_07.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipped_at >= '2021-12-01' AND shipped_at < '2022-01-01'

date_08.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE delivered_at - created_at > INTERVAL '5 days'

date_09.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

biz_01.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Complete'

biz_02.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE completed > 1) / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Complete') AS completed FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) t

biz_03.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT session_id, BOOL_OR(event_type = 'cart') AS carted, BOOL_OR(event_type = 'purchase') AS bought FROM events GROUP BY session_id) SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE carted AND NOT bought) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE carted), 0) FROM s

biz_04.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'cart') / COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM events

biz_05.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Complete'

biz_06.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete'

biz_07.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Returned'

biz_08.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*) FROM orders

biz_09.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE user_id IS NULL

biz_10.sql: SELECT traffic_source, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'purchase') / COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS rate FROM events GROUP BY traffic_source ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 1

empty_01.sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE age > 120

empty_02.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'Refunded'

empty_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE created_at < '2015-01-01'

empty_04.sql: SELECT AVG(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Spacesuits'

empty_05.sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE retail_price < 0

agg_01.sql: SELECT event_type FROM events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1

agg_02.sql: SELECT status, AVG(num_of_item) FROM orders GROUP BY status

agg_03.sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY age) FROM users

agg_04.sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY state ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

agg_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders

agg_06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) t

agg_07.sql: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

agg_08.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING MIN(created_at) >= '2022-01-01' AND MIN(created_at) < '2023-01-01') t

agg_09.sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (shipped_at - created_at)) / 86400.0) FROM orders WHERE shipped_at IS NOT NULL

agg_10.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
